title: Minimal Event Distance Aneuploidy Lineage Tree (MEDALT) Inference Protocol
author: Fang Wang
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfhpjj5n

steps.title: Install Dependencies and Tool
steps.instruction: Set up the required software environment and download the MEDALT tool.

substeps.instruction: Download the MEDALT tool from https://github.com/KChen-lab/MEDALT.git

steps.title: Prepare MEDALT Installation
steps.instruction: Decompress the tool package and navigate to the directory.

substeps.instruction: Decompress the gzipped files using: tar -zxvf MEDALT-1.0.tar.gz

steps.title: Prepare Input Dataset
steps.instruction: Ensure the input dataset is in an integer copy number profile format where columns correspond to chromosomal positions and rows correspond to cells.

substeps.instruction: Use single cell copy number profiles generated by single cell DNA-seq or inferred from single cell RNA-seq.

steps.title: Run MEDALT Inference
steps.instruction: Execute the scTree.py script with the appropriate parameters based on the data type.

substeps.instruction: For DNA-seq data: python scTree.py -P [PATH] -I [INPUT_FILE] -D D -G [GENOME_VERSION] -O [OUTPUT_PATH]
For RNA-seq data (e.g., inferCNV): python scTree.py -P [PATH] -I [INPUT_FILE] -D R -G [GENOME_VERSION] -O [OUTPUT_PATH]
Optional: Use -W [NUMBER] to specify the number of genes to merge for scRNA-seq data (default is 30).
Optional: Use -R T to reconstruct a permuted tree; otherwise, use -R F (default) to use a permuted copy number profile for LSA.

steps.title: Analyze Output Results
steps.instruction: Review the generated text files and visualizations in the output directory.

substeps.instruction: Check CNV.tree.txt for the rooted directed tree (columns: parent node, child node, and distance).
Check segmental.LSA.txt for broad CNAs significantly associated with lineage expansion.
Check gene.LSA.txt for focal (gene) CNAs significantly associated with lineage expansion.
View singlecell.tree.pdf for the MEDALT visualization (or import CNV.tree.txt into Cytoscape).
View LSA.tree.pdf for the visualization of identified CNAs.
